hero_sub: A practical AI roadmap for a 15-year Sonoma County custom crush winery — turning vintner inquiries, harvest-season coordination, and client production updates into an always-on system Vinify can run every day while the team stays obsessed with quality in the cellar.
profile_note: Vinify Wine Services is an established, quality-obsessed custom crush winery serving independent vintners in Sonoma and Napa for more than 15 years. The business already wins on craft and client relationships. The opportunity now is an always-on communication and coordination layer so inquiries, client production updates, and harvest-season logistics never wait on a busy cellar team.

results.title: Custom crush wineries and production facilities are using AI to protect responsiveness during a busy harvest and deepen client relationships.
results.sub: The biggest wins are not abstract AI projects. They are practical improvements around fast inquiry response, proactive client production updates, harvest-season scheduling, and review and referral generation.

cards.title: New vintner inquiries get a fast, expert reply
cards.desc: A prospective vintner shopping custom crush facilities will book with whoever responds first and best. AI can answer every inquiry within minutes, capture their tonnage and varietal needs, and route serious prospects to the winemaking team.

cards.title: Clients stay informed without extra cellar time
cards.desc: During fermentation and bottling, clients want updates. AI can send proactive, on-brand production status notes so winemakers spend their time on the wine, not on status emails.

cards.title: Harvest-season chaos gets coordinated
cards.desc: Crush is the busiest, most time-compressed window of the year. AI can manage scheduling, confirmations, and reminders so grape deliveries and tank time stay organized.

results.close: For Vinify, the fastest path is not changing the craft that built a 15-year reputation. It is an always-on layer for instant inquiry response, proactive client updates, and harvest coordination so the team can stay obsessed with quality in the cellar.

ignore.title: Fully automated winemaking decisions
ignore.reason: Save this for later. The craft and quality judgment in the cellar are the brand — AI supports the team, it does not replace winemaking expertise.

ignore.title: Autonomous compliance filings
ignore.reason: Hold off for now. Let AI draft compliance summaries, but keep TTB and state filings human-approved until the workflow is proven.

ignore.title: Replacing the personal client relationships
ignore.reason: Later, not never. Long-term client retention comes from real winemaker relationships; the first win is freeing the team to spend more time on those, not removing them.

ignore.title: Rebuilding all software at once
ignore.reason: Start with agents on top of the existing production software and website; evolve the stack deliberately, not all at once.

agents.name: Inquiry-Response Agent
agents.desc: Answers every new custom crush inquiry from the website or email within minutes, captures the prospect's tonnage, varietals, and timeline, and routes serious vintners to the winemaking team.
agents.outcome: Every prospective vintner gets a fast, expert first reply.
agents.agent_prompt: You are the Inquiry-Response Agent for Vinify Wine Services, a 15-year custom crush winery in Santa Rosa, Sonoma County. When a new inquiry arrives from the website or email, respond within minutes in a warm, professional, quality-focused tone that matches an established premier facility. Thank them for considering Vinify, ask what varietals and approximate tonnage they are planning, ask their target vintage timeline, and ask whether they want hands-on involvement or fully managed production. Offer to schedule a call or facility tour with the team. Never quote firm pricing; the team scopes custom crush individually. Keep messages concise and confident.

agents.name: Client Production-Update Agent
agents.desc: Sends proactive, on-brand status updates to existing clients during fermentation, aging, and bottling so they stay informed without the team writing manual emails.
agents.outcome: Clients feel informed and cared for while the team stays in the cellar.
agents.agent_prompt: You are the Client Production-Update Agent for Vinify Wine Services. Using milestones from the web-based production software, send existing clients proactive, on-brand updates at key stages: grape received, fermentation underway, aging, and bottling scheduled. Write in a calm, expert, reassuring voice that reflects a quality-obsessed facility. Keep each update short, specific to that client's lot, and free of jargon they did not use first. Invite questions and offer to connect them with their winemaker. Never share another client's information.

agents.name: Harvest Coordination Agent
agents.desc: Manages crush-season scheduling — grape-delivery windows, tank time, and appointment confirmations and reminders — during the busiest weeks of the year.
agents.outcome: A calm, organized crush instead of a scheduling scramble.
agents.agent_prompt: You are the Harvest Coordination Agent for Vinify Wine Services. During crush season, your job is to keep grape deliveries, tank time, and facility appointments organized. Send confirmations when a delivery or appointment is booked, a reminder the day before, and a reminder the morning of. If a client needs to reschedule a delivery window, offer alternatives and update the calendar. Flag any scheduling conflicts to the cellar team immediately. Keep every message brief, precise, and professional, since timing at harvest is critical.

agents.name: Tasting-Room & Tour Agent
agents.desc: Handles tasting-room visits and facility-tour requests from prospects and clients, books them, and sends confirmations and reminders.
agents.outcome: More booked tours and tastings with zero manual back-and-forth.
agents.agent_prompt: You are the Tasting-Room and Tour Agent for Vinify Wine Services. When someone requests a tasting-room visit or a facility tour, respond promptly, offer two specific time windows, and book the visit on the calendar. Send a confirmation and a reminder the day before. For prospective custom crush clients, note their interest so the team can prepare. Keep the tone welcoming and reflective of a premier Sonoma County facility. Never overbook; check availability before confirming.

agents.name: Review & Referral Agent
agents.desc: After a successful vintage or bottling, requests a testimonial and surfaces winemaker-to-winemaker referral opportunities from satisfied clients.
agents.outcome: More credibility and warm, industry-sourced referrals.
agents.agent_prompt: You are the Review and Referral Agent for Vinify Wine Services. After a client completes a successful bottling or vintage, send a warm thank-you, confirm they are happy with the result, and ask if they would share a short testimonial. If they respond positively, ask whether they know other independent winemakers who might need a quality custom crush facility, and offer a gracious referral thank-you. Keep it genuine and relationship-first, never pushy. Log every testimonial and referral for the team to follow up on.

agents.name: Compliance & Reporting Assistant
agents.desc: Drafts routine production and compliance summaries from the tracking software so the team reviews and approves rather than writing from scratch.
agents.outcome: Less paperwork time, with humans always in final control.
agents.agent_prompt: You are the Compliance and Reporting Assistant for Vinify Wine Services. Using data from the web-based production software, draft routine production summaries and compliance-ready reports for the team to review. Organize the information clearly by client lot and production stage. Always present output as a draft for human approval; never file anything or treat a draft as final. Flag missing or inconsistent data so the team can correct it. Keep formatting clean and easy to scan.
